notes.title: Studio Milestones
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! First and foremost, on behalf of the entire studio, I would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support and love towards our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757030/_/]latest work[/url], and we hope to continue receiving your support.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38700944/9542d9323e80e57002f96f52868f1fac79e6855c.png[/img]
After a period of adjustments, our focus has been on providing a more comfortable gaming experience, especially for new players. We have urgently optimized the combat and storyline features to prevent any lag caused by fast actions. Additionally, we have added a skip option for all storylines, allowing players to quickly progress and freely enjoy the game at their own pace.

Lastly, based on the voting results from our community, the development team is planning to create some additional action-packed DLC as a token of appreciation for the support and love from both new and existing players. We sincerely thank you for supporting our studio.

Furthermore, in the near future (around April 10th), we will be unveiling the store page for our upcoming title, "Muse War 2." We kindly request you to stay updated on our latest developments.

Once again, thank you all for your support and attention.

Best regards,

Happ Max

notes.title: Announcement: Studio Update
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce a new milestone for our studio after a year of silence. During this time, we have been working diligently behind the scenes to bring you an exciting new game - [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/apps/landing/2757030]Muse War[/url], a card-based battle game.

MuseWar is our latest release and promises players an incredibly strategic and thrilling gaming experience. In this game, players will assume the role of a mighty warrior wielding a massive sword, utilizing tactics, collecting powerful cards, and engaging in intense battles against other goddesses. We believe that MuseWar will become an addictive game, offering endless fun and challenges to players.

In addition to this exciting new project, we are also excited to introduce MuseWar 2, the next generation of our game. These new projects will feature cutting-edge 3D production technology, providing players with even more realistic and captivating gaming experiences. Our team has been working tirelessly on these projects and we hope to unveil them in the near future, bringing you fresh surprises and innovations.

We would like to express our gratitude to each and every member and partner for their support and trust in our studio. It is your support that enables us to continuously innovate and deliver highly anticipated new games and projects. Moving forward, we will continue to strive and bring you more exciting ventures and games.

If you have any questions or suggestions regarding our new games or any other matters, please feel free to reach out to us. We are eager to maintain close collaboration with you and provide you with the best gaming experience possible.

Once again, we sincerely thank you for your support!

Best regards,

Happy Max Studio Team

notes.title: “Muse:Valkiri&Dungeon” will be published as Early Access on 13th, July
notes.content:
Store address: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1930740/

Please add a wish list to follow.

Introduction to the game:
This is a combination of third-person and first-person shooter game.
As a warrior, you should break through seven stages to rescue Valkyries from demonic control.

Increase power by rescuing Valkyries
Continued success of rescuing Valkyries will render you increasing fighting capacity and skills, which can help you beat the game.

Collect rewards in repeated attack
Corresponding move of the Valkyrie will be unlocked after the first level accomplished. More attack brings you additional rewards. Each Valkyrie has four moves (The full version will have 7 Valkyries (currently only 4)).
